about_the_game:
Love is in the air... and it smells like coffee, printer paper, and desperation. Welcome to Crushing on the Clock, a unique dating sim where your 9-to-5 is just the prelude to your real mission: hooking up with your cute coworkers!

You play as Johni, the new hire, who finally got a job to start his adult life, but soon discovers the office is full of potential romance. Will you find his perfect match(es)?

❤️ 5 Characters you can date, 17 Characters that you interact with

🎬 80+ Fully animated scenes, 45+ Illustrated backgrounds (Several animated)

🗣️ Partial Voicing for all main characters

🎵 24 Musical background compositions with Dozens of sound effects

🛒 Over 60+ items to purchase with multiple shops and services

🎮 Mini ga​mes, Random Texts/Calls and events matrix with a time matrix

🎲 Multiple random events based on actions, progression, looks/energy/mood and work status

🏆 Trackable achievement room and Steam achievements (if playing on Steam)

❤️How to Work a Heart:

Your journey from coworkers to couple is a two-phase operation:

1. The Grind: Earn Your Shot

  • Get to Know Them: Use your workday wisely! Strike up conversations and help your potential future relationships flourish. Your choices here determine if you're seen as just a coworker or something more. Your oddly helpful, but creepy boss is there to give you pointers.

  • Secure the Digits: Successfully navigate the workplace small talk and you'll earn that precious phone number, unlocking the next level of your relationship.

2. The Date: A Battle of Wits and Charm

  • Engage the "Rizz-Turn" Combat System: Dating is the ultimate turn-based strategy game! Manage your limited Rizz Points to choose the perfect compliments, tell engaging stories, and create romantic moments. Pick the wrong move and watch your date—and your chances—fizzle out.

  • Prepare for Victory: A successful date requires preparation.

    • Shop for Success: Hit the mall to buy gifts that show you're listening and clothes that show you care.

    • Look the Part: Spend time at the gym to boost your confidence and your appeal.

    • Fuel Up: A well-timed coffee from the local shop can be the key to unlocking your best dialogue options.

🎮Game Features:

  • Office Romances: Meet, chat with, and date a diverse cast of female coworkers, each with their own personalities, preferences, and storylines.

  • Strategic Dating: The unique "Rizz-Turn" system makes every date a thrilling, choice-driven challenge. Think before you speak!

  • Live Your Life: Balance your wallet, your wardrobe, and your workout routine to become the most datable version of yourself.

  • Multiple Endings: Your choices matter! Pursue your favorite girl and discover a unique ending for each successful relationship.

  • A World to Explore: From the office, to your apartment, to an entire town, explore various 2D and animated environments that bring the story to life.

  • Romantic Aesthetic: Enjoy a beautifully crafted world with a charming anime-inspired art style.

  • Immersive Multimedia: The story is complemented by a fitting soundtrack, sound effects, and special video clips that enhance key moments.

It's time to clock into your fantasy love life. Are you ready to find your crush on the clock?

content_descriptors.notes: Crushing on the Clock is dating sim with references to sexual behavior.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 (modern generation) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel UHD 600+, AMD Vega 3+) or dedicated GPU with 2GB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: ntel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 4GB+ VRAM (GTX 1650, RX 5500, or better)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
